title: Local News Lost 2,835 US Newspapers
hook: Local news lost 2,835 newspapers, leaving towns without watchdogs.
closing: Without local reporting, fewer people see what their town decides.
question: Do you know your local reporter?

segments.say: Local news lost 2,835 US newspapers. Roughly two in five outlets vanished, leaving fewer reporters watching public decisions.
Local news disappeared entirely in 208 counties. Those communities now lack even one dedicated source.
Local news is scarce for 15% of Americans. Millions can miss decisions made close to home.
